請在 Vela 輸入這個代碼，連結您的 Telegram 帳號：{code}

column4: Vela’s English trial is invitation-only. Contact the founder for access. Your Telegram ID: {telegram_id}.

選哪一張呢？請按 1 或 2。

column4: Nothing new from the family today. How are you this morning?
column5: 今天家人沒有新的消息。您早上過得好嗎？

column4: Reply with a voice message, or tap a button.
column5: 您可以傳語音訊息回覆，或按下面的按鈕。

Thank you, {address}. Your story is kept in the family book.
column5: 謝謝您，{address}。您說的故事已經收進家庭故事書了。

column4: That's fine. This story is no longer in the family book.
column5: 沒問題，這則故事已經從家庭故事書拿掉了。

column4: Kept. Your {title} is in the family book now.
column5: 好的，{title}已經收進家庭故事書了。

column4: That's fine. This recipe is not kept.
column5: 沒問題，這份食譜不保留。

column4: This link is no longer valid. Please ask the person who sent it for a new one.
column5: 這個連結已經失效了。請跟傳連結給您的人再要一個新的。

column4: This Telegram account is already connected to another family on Vela.
column5: 這個 Telegram 帳號已經連結到 Vela 上的另一個家庭。

column4: {organiser} would like to keep a light on for you. Every morning someone in the family will ask you something, and when you answer, they will know you are fine. If a morning goes unanswered, {organiser} will get a quiet note so they can call. You can say stop at any time. Vela is run by Timur Aiusheev. How your information is used: {notice}
column5: {organiser}想為您留一盞燈。每天早上，家裡會有人問您一件事。您回覆了，家人就知道您一切都好。如果哪天早上的訊息一直沒有回覆，{organiser}會收到一則簡短的通知，就可以打電話給您。您隨時都可以說「停」。Vela 由 Timur Aiusheev 經營。您的資料會怎麼使用，請看： {notice}

column4: One more question. If you mention your health, for example a fall or pain, may Vela pass your words on to {organiser} so they can call you? Vela works the same if you say no.
column5: 還有一個問題。如果您提到身體狀況，例如跌倒或哪裡痛，Vela 可以把您說的話轉告{organiser}，讓{organiser}打電話給您嗎？就算您說不要，Vela 也會照常運作。

column4: Thank you. Your first morning arrives tomorrow at {time}.
column5: 謝謝您。第一則早安訊息會在明天 {time} 送到。
沒關係，不會傳任何訊息給您。

column4: {name} said yes. The first morning arrives tomorrow at {time}.
column5: {name}同意了。第一則早安訊息會在明天 {time} 送到。

column4: {name} said no for now. Nothing will be sent.
column5: {name}說暫時先不要。不會傳送任何訊息。

column4: Hello {name}, it is {organiser}. I would like to keep a light on for you: one small question from the family each morning. Open this to hear about it, and say yes if you would like it: {link} You can say stop at any time.
column5: {name}您好，我是{organiser}。我想為您留一盞燈：每天早上，家人會問您一件小事。打開這個連結看看，願意的話就說好： {link} 您隨時都可以說「停」。

column4: Here is a new invite. Send this link to {name}: {link} It works for 7 days.
column5: 這是新的邀請連結。請把這個連結傳給{name}： {link} 連結 7 天內有效。

column4: Everything is paused. Say start whenever you would like it back.
column5: 已經全部暫停了。想恢復的時候，隨時說「開始」就可以了。

column4: Welcome back. Your next morning arrives at {time}.
column5: 歡迎回來。下一則早安訊息會在 {time} 送到。

column4: {name} asked to pause. Nothing is wrong with the app.
What the family saw from your latest answers:
column5: 家人從您最近的回覆看到的是：

column4: Nothing yet. When you answer a morning message, the family will see it.
column5: 還沒有內容。您回覆早安訊息之後，家人就會看到。

column4: From the latest weekly read sent to the family:
column5: 最近一次傳給家人的每週小記裡，關於您這一週的幾行：

column4: Hello, family. I'm Vela. Each evening I will say whose turn it is to ask {name} something for the morning. How Vela handles your messages: {notice}
column5: 大家好，我是 Vela。每天晚上，我會告訴大家明天早上輪到誰問{name}一件事。Vela 如何處理大家的訊息： {notice}

column4: Only the family organiser can connect Vela to a group.
column5: 只有家庭的發起人才能把 Vela 連結到群組。

column4: Tomorrow is {holder}'s turn with {name}. Reply to this message with a question, a photo, or a voice note.
column5: 明天輪到{holder}問{name}。請直接回覆這則訊息，傳一個問題、一張照片或一段語音。

column4: Tomorrow, anyone can ask {name} something. Reply to this message with a question, a photo, or a voice note.
column5: 明天大家都可以問{name}一件事。請直接回覆這則訊息，傳一個問題、一張照片或一段語音。

column4: Tomorrow already has {asker}'s ask. This one is saved for another morning.
column5: 明天已經有{asker}的提問了。這則先保留，改天早上再送出。
{asker}已經為{name}準備好明天早上的提問。

column4: It's been quiet at {name}'s today. The morning message went out at {sent}; {name} usually answers by {usual}. Nothing worrying is known.
column5: {name}那邊今天比較安靜。早安訊息在 {sent} 送出；{name}通常會在 {usual} 前回覆。目前沒有任何令人擔心的消息。

column4: It's been quiet at {name}'s today. The morning message went out at {sent}. Nothing worrying is known.
column5: {name}那邊今天比較安靜。早安訊息在 {sent} 送出。目前沒有任何令人擔心的消息。

column4: {name} answered at {time}. Everything is lit again.
We couldn't reach {name} on {channel} today. Nothing else is known.
column5: 今天沒辦法透過 {channel} 把訊息送給{name}。除此之外，目前沒有別的消息。

column4: {name} said something you may want to hear: "{quote}"
column5: {name}說了一句話，您可能會想知道：「{quote}」

column4: {name} said something today that may be worth a call.
column5: {name}今天說了一些話，也許值得打個電話問問。

column4: It's been quiet at {name}'s today. The morning's message arrived at {sent}. Open Vela to call or wait.
column5: {name}那邊今天比較安靜。早安訊息在 {sent} 送到。打開 Vela，可以打個電話，也可以再等等。

column4: Tomorrow morning is yours: ask {name} something.
column5: 明天早上輪到您了：問問{name}一件事吧。

column4: Until {date}, then. Have a lovely time.
column5: 好的，那就到{date}為止。祝您過得愉快。
好的，知道了。祝您過得愉快。
{name}這週 {days} 天中回覆了 {answered} 天。
{name}這週 {days} 天中回覆了 {answered} 天。

column4: On {mornings} mornings nobody in the family asked, so Vela sent {name} a hello.
column5: 有 {mornings} 天早上家裡沒有人提問，Vela 就傳了早安問候給{name}。

column4: On {mornings} morning nobody in the family asked, so Vela sent {name} a hello.
column5: 有 {mornings} 天早上家裡沒有人提問，Vela 就傳了早安問候給{name}。

column4: Nobody in the family asked {name} anything this week.
column5: 這週家裡沒有人問{name}任何事。

column4: Hello. To set up Vela for your family, send /start.
column5: 您好。想為家人設定 Vela 的話，請傳送 /start。

column4: Hello, I'm Vela. If someone in your family sent you an invitation, open it now. To set up Vela for your own family, send /start.
column5: 您好，我是 Vela。如果家人傳了邀請給您，請現在打開。想為自己的家人設定 Vela，請傳 /start。

column4: {organiser} asks: you live near {name}. On a day when {name} hasn't answered and {organiser} can't get through, may {organiser} ask you, through Vela, to go round? Vela never writes to you on its own: any request comes from {organiser}. If you say yes, Vela keeps your name and this Telegram account until you or {organiser} remove them. You can say no, or change your mind at any time by sending stop. Vela is a pilot run by Timur Aiusheev. How your details are used: {notice}
column5: {organiser}想問您：您住在{name}附近。如果哪天{name}一直沒有回覆，{organiser}又聯絡不上，{organiser}可以透過 Vela 請您過去看看嗎？Vela 不會自己傳訊息給您：任何請求都來自{organiser}。如果您同意，Vela 會保存您的名字和這個 Telegram 帳號，直到您或{organiser}把它們移除。您可以說不，也可以隨時傳送「停」改變主意。Vela 是由 Timur Aiusheev 經營的試辦服務。您的資料會怎麼使用，請看： {notice}

column4: Thank you. Vela will write to you only if {organiser} asks you to look in on {name}. Send stop at any time to be removed.
column5: 謝謝您。只有在{organiser}請您過去看看{name}的時候，Vela 才會傳訊息給您。隨時傳送「停」就可以移除。

column4: That's fine. Your details have been deleted, and nobody will ask again.
column5: 沒關係。您的資料已經刪除，不會再有人問您。

column4: You are already listed near {name}. Nothing has changed.
column5: 您已經列在{name}附近的人裡了，沒有任何變更。

column4: {organiser} asks: could you look in on {name} today? {name} hasn't answered this morning.
column5: {organiser}想問您：今天可以過去看看{name}嗎？{name}今天早上還沒有回覆。

column4: Thank you. {organiser} knows you'll look in.
column5: 謝謝您。{organiser}已經知道您會過去。

column4: Thank you for letting {organiser} know. That's completely fine.
column5: 謝謝您讓{organiser}知道，完全沒關係。

column4: {name} has answered now, so there is no need to look in. Thank you.
column5: {name}已經回覆了，不用過去了。謝謝您。

column4: You have been removed. Vela will not write to you again.
column5: 已經為您移除，Vela 不會再傳訊息給您。

column4: Vela writes to you only when a family that listed you asks you to look in. Send stop to be removed.
column5: 只有在列出您的家庭請您過去看看時，Vela 才會傳訊息給您。傳送「停」就可以移除。

column4: {contact} said yes. On a quiet morning you can now ask {contact} to look in on {name}.
column5: {contact}同意了。之後如果哪天早上比較安靜，您可以請{contact}過去看看{name}。

column4: {contact} said no, so {contact} is no longer listed near {name}.
column5: {contact}說不用了，所以{contact}已經不在{name}附近的人裡。

column4: Hello, I'm Vela. Let's set up a light for someone in your family. It takes two minutes.
column5: 您好，我是 Vela。我們一起為一位家人留一盞燈吧。大約兩分鐘就能完成。

column4: What do you call them? For example: Mom, Grandma, Dad.
column5: 您平常怎麼稱呼這位家人？例如：媽媽、阿嬤、爸爸。

column4: How should I greet them each morning? For example: Mrs Chen, Mom.
column5: 我每天早上問候時，要怎麼稱呼這位家人？例如：陳太太、媽媽。

column4: Which language should their messages be in?
column5: 要用哪一種語言傳訊息給這位家人？

column4: Which country do they live in?
column5: 這位家人住在哪個國家或地區？

column4: Which time zone do they live in? Type its name, like Asia/Seoul or Europe/Paris.
column5: 這位家人住在哪個時區？請輸入時區名稱，例如 Asia/Seoul 或 Europe/Paris。

column4: Please send a time zone name like Asia/Seoul or Europe/Paris.
column5: 請輸入像 Asia/Seoul 或 Europe/Paris 這樣的時區名稱。

column4: When do they usually wake up? Tap one or type a time like 07:30.
column5: 這位家人通常幾點起床？請按一個選項，或輸入像 07:30 這樣的時間。

column4: Who lives nearby and could look in if needed? Send a name and, if you like, how they know each other, for example: Anna, neighbour. Or tap Skip. Please ask them yourself first. Only their name goes here: their number is added after they say yes.
column5: 有沒有住在附近、需要的時候可以過去看看的人？請傳送對方的名字，也可以加上對方和這位家人的關係，例如：王小姐，鄰居。或按「略過」。請您先親自問過對方。這裡只填名字：對方同意之後，才會加上電話號碼。

column4: Please send only a name and, if you like, how they know each other, for example: Anna, neighbour. Their number is added after they say yes.
column5: 請只傳送名字，也可以加上對方和這位家人的關係，例如：王小姐，鄰居。對方同意之後，才會加上電話號碼。
請輸入像 07:30 這樣的時間。

column4: All set. Send this link to {name}: {link} Then start a new group for the family, without {name}, and add me to it, so the family can take turns asking.
column5: 設定完成。請把這個連結傳給{name}： {link} 然後另外建立一個家人群組（不要加{name}），把我加進去，讓家人可以輪流提問。

column4: Weekly read draft for {family} is ready: {link}
column5: {family}的每週小記草稿已經準備好了： {link}

column4: Could not read an answer in {family} after three tries. Open: {link}
column5: {family}有一則回覆試了三次仍無法讀取。查看： {link}

column4: {name} left the family group in {family}. Nothing changed for them.
column5: {name}退出了{family}的家人群組。{name}這邊沒有任何變動。

column4: {name} can no longer be told anything in {family}, and no other organiser can: nobody will hear if a light there goes quiet. Open: {link}
column5: {family}已經無法再通知{name}，也沒有其他發起人能收到通知：那裡有人安靜下來時，不會有人知道。查看： {link}

column4: It's been quiet at {name}'s today in {family}, and no organiser can be told. Open: {link}
column5: {family}的{name}那邊今天比較安靜，但沒有任何發起人能收到通知。查看： {link}

column5: LINE 本月已用了 {used} 則訊息，上限是 {limit} 則。查看： {link}

column4: LINE has used all of this month's messages: mornings and notices on LINE fail until the plan changes or the month ends, and only replies still go out. Open: {link}
column5: LINE 本月的訊息額度已經用完：在方案變更或下個月開始之前，LINE 上的早安訊息和通知都會傳送失敗，只有回覆還能送出。查看： {link}

column4: It's been quiet at {name}'s today in {family}, and the notice to an organiser's phone did not arrive. Open: {link}
column5: {family}的{name}那邊今天比較安靜，但傳到一位發起人手機的通知沒有送達。查看： {link}

column5: 推播通知無法送出：Vela 的推播憑證被拒絕了，修好之前，任何通知都到不了手機。查看： {link}

那個週日已經由{holder}安排了。

column4: Ask {name} for permission before saving their number. It stays encrypted on this iPhone, is never uploaded to Vela, and is removed when you sign out. Your usual Telegram chat still works without it.
column5: 儲存{name}的號碼前，請先徵得對方同意。號碼會加密保存在這支 iPhone 上，不會上傳到 Vela，登出時就會刪除。不存號碼，您平常的 Telegram 聊天也照樣能用。

column4: Ask her which seeds she wants to keep for next spring.

column4: At most one of each a day: when {her} answers what you asked, and the evening before your turn. If a morning goes quiet, you are told whatever this says.

column4: Both of you, but only Mia listened about the butter.
column5: 你們兩個都教過，但只有 Mia 把奶油那段聽進去了。

column4: Choose your country, type your number as you would at home, and we text you a code.

column5: 要用聲音回答，Vela 需要使用麥克風。請家人幫您在「設定」裡打開。

column4: Today could not be reached just now.
column5: 目前無法載入今天的內容。

column4: Today's ask reached {name} at {time}, and again at {timeAgain}.
column5: 今天的提問在 {time} 送到{name}那裡，{timeAgain} 又送了一次。
今天的提問在 {time} 送到{name}那裡。

column4: Today's ask reached {name} at 8:00, and again at 11:00.
column5: 今天的提問在 08:00 送到{name}那裡，11:00 又送了一次。

column4: Too many photos for now. Try again later.
column5: 目前照片太多了，請稍後再試。

column4: Too many photos for now. Try again tomorrow.
column5: 目前照片太多了，請明天再試。

column4: Turn on notifications, and this phone tells you if her morning goes quiet, and when she answers what you asked.
column5: 開啟通知後，如果這位家人的早上比較安靜，或是回覆了您的提問，這支手機都會通知您。

column4: Two people nearby is the most.
column5: 附近的聯絡人最多兩位。

column4: Two people nearby is the most. Remove one to add someone else.
column5: 附近的聯絡人最多兩位。請先移除一位，再加入其他人。

column4: Type your email, and we send you a code.
column5: 輸入您的電子郵件，我們會寄驗證碼給您。

column4: Up to two people who could look in if a morning goes quiet: a neighbour, a friend downstairs. Vela asks each of them first, and nobody hears from Vela until then.
column5: 最多兩位住在附近、在早上安靜時可以過去看看的人：例如鄰居、樓下的朋友。Vela 會先徵求每一位的同意，在那之前，沒有人會收到 Vela 的訊息。

column4: Up to two people who live close to {name} and could look in if a morning goes quiet. Send each one a link with Ask on Telegram: Vela writes to them only once they open it, and asks them in your name. Until they say yes, you can call them yourself.
column5: 最多兩位住在{name}附近、如果哪天早上比較安靜可以過去看看的人。用「在 Telegram 上問」傳連結給每一位：只有在對方打開連結後，Vela 才會以您的名義傳訊息問對方。在對方同意之前，您可以自己打電話給對方。

column4: Vela does not send notifications from here yet.
column5: Vela 目前還不會從這裡傳送通知。

column4: Vela Light is on for {name} until {date}. Nothing is charged, and no card was asked for.
column5: {name}的 Vela Light 已開啟，到 {date}為止。不收任何費用，也沒有要求提供信用卡。

column4: Vela Light shows you the read
column5: Vela Light 會讓您看到完整小記

column4: Vela needs the microphone for a voice hello. You can allow it in Settings.
column5: 錄語音問候需要使用麥克風，您可以在「設定」中允許。

column4: Vela needs the microphone for a voice reply. You can allow it in Settings.
column5: 語音回覆需要使用麥克風，您可以在「設定」中允許。

column4: Vela shows a month once it has at least {notices} notices from {families} families, so no one family's morning can be read out of it.
column5: 一個月要至少有來自{families}個家庭的{notices}則通知，Vela 才會顯示，這樣就看不出任何一個家庭的早上。

column4: Vela suggests · from her own words
column5: Vela 的建議 · 取自這位家人說過的話

column4: Voice hello, {time}. It plays before your ask.
column5: 語音問候，共 {time}。會在您的提問之前播放。

column4: Voice note, {time}. She hears it in her morning.
column5: 語音，{time}。早上會播給對方聽。

column4: Waiting for today to arrive. Your words are kept.
column5: 正在載入今天的資料。您寫的內容都還在。

column4: Waiting two hours. You will hear again at 13:00 if it is still quiet.
column5: 會再等 2 小時。到時候如果還是比較安靜，13:00 會再通知您。

column4: Waiting until {time}. You will hear again then if it is still quiet.
column5: 會等到 {time}。到時候如果還是比較安靜，會再通知您。
我們已經把驗證碼傳到 {sentTo}。

column4: We sent a code to your email.
column5: 我們已經把驗證碼寄到您的電子信箱。

column4: What {name} told you this week, what came up twice, and something to ask her next. The first 30 days are free.
column5: {name}這週跟您說了什麼、哪些事提了兩次，以及下次可以問{name}什麼。前 30 天免費。

column4: What are you looking forward to this week?
column5: 這週有什麼讓您期待的事嗎？

column4: What did the garden look like this morning?
column5: 今天早上花園看起來怎麼樣？

column4: What did you have for breakfast?
What seeds did you save from last year's garden?
column5: 去年花園裡的種子，您留下了哪些？

column4: What the family sees about you
column5: 家人看得到您的哪些資訊

column4: What was your favourite meal as a child?
column5: 您小時候最喜歡吃什麼？
您要傳給這位家人的內容

column4: When a morning stays quiet, Vela tells you. Here is how those notices ended. Most end with an answer that came later, or a day away.
column5: 早上一直很安靜時，Vela 會通知您。這裡是那些通知最後的結果。大多數是稍晚才回覆，或那天正好外出。

column4: When she answers what you asked, and the evening before your turn.
column5: 家人回覆您的提問時，以及輪到您提問的前一晚。

column4: When you are with {name}, sign in to Vela on her phone and set it up there. Her phone then shows one message at a time in large words, and asks her first; nothing reaches her until she says yes.
column5: 和{name}在一起時，在長輩的手機上登入 Vela 並完成設定。之後那支手機一次只顯示一則大字訊息，並先徵求對方同意；對方答應之前，不會收到任何訊息。

column4: Which one do you like more?
Which one of us did you teach to make the pies?
column5: 您當初是教我們哪一個做派的？

column4: Who are you keeping a light on for?
With your light on, they also see whether you answered each morning and when, and are told if it stays quiet.
column5: 您的燈亮著時，家人也會看到您每天早上有沒有回覆、幾點回覆；如果一直很安靜，家人也會收到通知。

column4: You are paused: no turns come to you, and you are not told if it goes quiet.
column5: 您目前暫停中：不會輪到您提問，安靜的日子也不會通知您。

column4: You are paused: no turns come to you.
column5: 您目前暫停中：不會輪到您提問。

column4: You are signed in to Vela.
You are the only organiser who is active, and an organiser who is away is not told if it goes quiet. Someone else who organises the family has to be active first.
column5: 目前只有您一位發起人在使用中，而暫停的發起人在安靜的日子不會收到通知。必須先有這個家庭的另一位發起人在使用中。

column4: You can also do it later, from You → Her phone.
column5: 也可以之後再設定：我 → 長輩的手機。

column4: You can reply once she has answered.
column5: 等這位家人回覆之後，您就可以回應。

column4: You said {name} is fine. Nothing else was sent.
column5: 您說{name}沒事。沒有再傳送其他訊息。

column4: You will stop seeing the family's days and taking turns. Thirty days on, what is kept about you is deleted.
column5: 您將不再看到家人的日常，也不會再輪流提問。三十天後，保存的關於您的資料會被刪除。

column4: Your family could not be reached just now.
column5: 目前無法載入您的家庭。

column4: Your light is off, so nothing about your mornings is shown.
column5: 您的燈沒有亮著，所以不會顯示任何關於您早上的內容。

column4: Your light is paused from your own chat, where your mornings arrive.
column5: 您的燈要從您自己的聊天室暫停，也就是您收到早安訊息的地方。

column4: Your mobile number. The country code is added for you.
column5: 您的手機號碼。國碼會自動幫您加上。

column4: Your name, as the family says it.
column5: 您的名字，用家人平常的叫法。

column4: Your name, the asks you write, and your replies.
column5: 您的名字、您寫的提問，以及您的回覆。

column4: Your parent can ask “what does the family see” in their own Telegram chat. Health-word sharing is their separate choice, and saying stop pauses their light.
column5: 您的父母可以在自己的 Telegram 聊天室裡問「家人看到什麼」。是否轉告身體狀況由長輩另外決定，說「停止」就會暫停長輩的燈。

column4: Your pilot is free. Quiet notices and important updates arrive in the organiser’s private Telegram chat.
column5: 試辦免費。安靜通知和重要訊息會送到發起人的 Telegram 私人聊天室。
